Senhive is a technology leader specialising in advanced counter-drone systems and autonomous sensor networks designed for high-security and mission-critical environments. Leveraging cutting-edge detection, tracking, and mitigation technologies, Senhive provides robust, real-time solutions in support of air traffic management systems and protects airspace from unauthorized or hostile drone activity. Serving defence, aerospace, security and critical infrastructure sectors, Senhive enhances situational awareness and operational security through intelligent, scalable, and resilient systems.
 

Job description
 

As Purchasing & Logistics Assistant, you will play a key role in keeping our purchasing and logistics operations running smoothly. You will ensure that the materials and components our teams need are ordered on time, that deliveries are properly received and processed, and that outgoing shipments are prepared accurately and efficiently.
 

Your responsibilities cover the entire operational flow, from placing purchase orders and coordinating with suppliers to checking incoming invoices and preparing shipments for customers and partners. When products are unavailable or delivery dates change, you take the initiative to find suitable alternatives and keep things moving.
 

In addition to the above, you will also contribute to the smooth day-to-day running of our office by taking care of a range of general and very practical facility and office management tasks.
 

This is a hands-on role combining practical warehouse and logistics activities with administrative & office-related responsibilities. We are therefore looking for someone who works proactively, takes ownership of their responsibilities and naturally spots what needs to be done. You enjoy bringing structure to day-to-day operations, solving practical problems and making sure things get done without having to be asked twice. 
 

More details in PDF file enclosed. 
 

 

Your profile
 

We are looking for someone who is organised, proactive and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership and a practical approach to problem-solving.
 

You have:
 

• At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in purchasing, logistics, supply chain, warehouse administration or a comparable operational role. 
• Excellent knowledge of Dutch and English, both written and spoken). 
• Strong administrative skills and an eye for detail, particularly when handling orders, delivery documents and invoices. 
• The ability to organise your work independently, set priorities and follow up on outstanding tasks. 
• A proactive mindset: you identify what needs attention, anticipate potential issues and take action without waiting for instructions. 
• A solution-oriented attitude and the ability to find practical alternatives when things do not go according to plan. 
• The flexibility to switch between administrative tasks and hands-on operational work throughout the day. 
• Confidence in communicating with suppliers, couriers, colleagues and other external contacts. 
• A reliable and structured approach, with a strong focus on accuracy, follow-up and getting things done. 
• A willingness to take ownership of both the bigger picture and the smaller practical details that keep an organisation running smoothly.
 

You are comfortable working at a desk when the task requires it, but you are equally happy to receive deliveries, check goods and take care of practical logistics activities. You understand that a well-functioning operation depends on both accurate administration and effective execution.
 

Given the practical and on-site nature of this role, you live within maximum 30 minutes' driving distance of our workplace in Hasselt.
 

Experience with purchase order systems, ERP software, courier platforms and international shipping documentation is an advantage.

Compliance • Conformity • Governance • Operational Readiness • License to Operate
  
 
  
PMO-C²Trust — Turning Compliance and Conformity into Operational Readiness.
  
Are you an experienced Project Manager who thrives in complex industrial environments where engineering, compliance, safety, permitting and operational readiness converge? Do you enjoy bringing structure to multidisciplinary projects and helping clients navigate regulatory and conformity requirements with confidence? Then the role of PMO-C²Trust Project Manager could be your next challenge.
  
 
  
About PMO-C²Trust: PMO-C²Trust is Kiwa Vinçotte's governance framework for complex industrial investment and engineering projects. Our mission is to help clients translate compliance, conformity and operational requirements into a structured, traceable and manageable project approach that supports a successful License to Operate. We connect project objectives, regulatory obligations, engineering activities, stakeholder responsibilities, conformity requirements and commissioning readiness into one integrated governance model. By creating visibility, accountability and evidence throughout the project lifecycle, we help clients reduce risk, avoid late surprises and achieve safe and compliant project delivery.
  
 
  
Your Mission: as a PMO-C²Trust Project Manager, you guide industrial projects from early project definition through engineering, construction, commissioning and operational release. You ensure that compliance, conformity, safety and permitting requirements are identified at an early stage, translated into practical project actions and managed through to successful completion. You act as a trusted governance partner for clients and create alignment between asset owners, engineering teams, suppliers, contractors, inspection bodies and certification organisations. Your work contributes directly to safe start-up, operational readiness and long-term compliance.
  
 
  
Your Responsibilities:
  
 
  
Compliance & Conformity Management
    
• Identify and assess applicable European, national and regional legislation.  
• Develop compliance and conformity roadmaps for industrial projects.  
• Translate requirements related to CE Marking, the EU Blue Guide and regulatory frameworks into clear project deliverables.  
• Coordinate interfaces with inspection bodies, notified bodies, certification organisations and authorities.  
• Support clients in managing compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.   
Project Governance & Stakeholder Management
    
• Establish project governance structures, reporting lines and decision-making processes.  
• Facilitate stakeholder alignment across clients, engineering teams, contractors and suppliers.  
• Define responsibilities, interfaces and escalation paths.  
• Support steering committees, reviews and key project decision points.   
Operational Readiness & License to Operate
    
• Integrate conformity, safety, environmental and commissioning requirements into project execution.  
• Coordinate the collection and management of required evidence and project documentation.  
• Monitor project readiness, compliance status and key risks.  
• Support evidence-based decisions for commissioning, handover and ...

Education & Experience
    
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Technology or another relevant technical discipline.  
• Minimum 5 years of experience in industrial, engineering, infrastructure, energy or manufacturing projects.  
• Proven experience in multidisciplinary project management.  
• Experience with industrial commissioning, conformity assessment, compliance management or operational readiness programmes is a strong asset.  
• Project Management certification (PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2 or equivalent) is considered a plus.   
Knowledge & Affinity
  
You have experience or affinity with several of the following domains:
    
• European product legislation and conformity assessment;  
• CE Marking and EU Blue Guide principles;  
• EU New Legislative Framework (NLF);  
• Industrial commissioning and operational readiness;  
• Environmental permitting and compliance requirements;  
• Occupational safety and statutory inspections;  
• Governance, stakeholder management and stage-gate methodologies.   
Knowledge of Belgian and Flemish environmental legislation, including VLAREM, is a strong asset.
  
Your strength lies in connecting expertise, asking the right questions and translating complex requirements into a coherent project approach.
  
 
  
Competencies
  
You:
    
• Translate complexity into structure and action.  
• Are comfortable working with both technical specialists and senior stakeholders.  
• Proactively identify risks, gaps and opportunities.  
• Combine ownership with strong organisational skills.  
• Balance regulatory rigour with practical project delivery.  
• Build trust through a professional, solution-oriented approach.   
Languages
    
• Dutch: Fluent  
• English: Professional proficiency  
• French: Strong asset   
You are willing to travel within Belgium and occasionally across Europe.
